fusions.name: Long Arm
fusions.desc: Swings a chain at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 4 damage, up to 1.8 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Wrecking Swing
fusions.desc: Swings a heavy chain in a full circle that deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each one back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Hand Over Hand
fusions.desc: Hooks a chain ahead of you and swings you 5 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Grips Back
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds and the enemy you hit moves 20% slower for 2 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
